name: IconProvider
purpose: Adds to or replaces the built-in icons, by name.

types.BuiltInIconName: one of the names listed under Icons
types.IconLibraryOverrides: {} (an app augments it to register its own icon names)
types.IconNode: { tag: string; attr: Record<string, string | number | undefined>; child: IconNode[] }
types.NativeIcon: IconNode | ComponentType<{ size: number; color: string }>
